expected_findings.description: Positional construction of AgentRunResult with three consecutive booleans (errored, paused, fatal) is hard to read and risks silent corruption if field order changes; keyword arguments are recommended.
The emit_events=True branch and log.append() calls in error event emission and output validation failure are not exercised by any unit test.
The nullcontext() path when coordinator is None and the should_pause check being skipped lack dedicated test coverage.
The validate_agent_output exception handler that wraps exceptions into AgentRunResult with synthesized error events is not exercised by any unit test.
The raise SubagentSuspended(); yield pattern required to create an async generator is fragile and odd, though documented with # pragma: no cover.
